name: MOSHER
label: Mosher
description: Mosher: heavy fists, a wide stance and stepped spikes. The head keeps its original size.

name: GUITAR DEMON
label: Guitar Demon
description: Guitar Demon: an elongated body, a guitar made from plates and a long claw arm. No special string or joint parts.

name: STAGE SPIDER
label: Stage Spider
description: Stage Spider: a drummer grows four arms, four supporting legs and a drum built into its torso.

name: BASS TITAN
label: Bass Titan
description: Bass Titan: one speaker grows into four sculpted speaker cones. The chest, boots and two horns behind the shoulders grow larger.

name: WINGED FRONTMAN
label: Winged Frontman
description: Winged Frontman: a short cape opens into two stepped wings. The legs and claw arm grow longer while the microphone stays near the face.
